name: mt_bench_indonesian
description:
MT-Bench Indonesian
	


  


This repo contains the Indonesian translation for the popular MT-Bench dataset.
This dataset was translated first by GPT-4o, and then corrected by an Indonesian speaker, Aulia Adila, who is both an Indonesian native and a data analyst.
This is part of three language datasets that we have added to the MT-Bench benchmark:

Indonesian
Polish
Vietnamese

This dataset was uploaded by Peter Devine (ptrdvn)
reputation: Community-contributed translation of the popular MT-Bench; useful for Indonesian evaluation but has limited formal adoption compared to the original MT-Bench.
